epicJql: ((project = RHAI and issuetype = Epic and component IN ("AIPCC Productization", "AIPCC Ecosystems") and status != Closed and (labels IN ("aipcc-ecosystems-portfolio-tracking", "package") or parent is empty)) or (project = AIPCC and issuetype = Epic and labels IN ("aipcc-ecosystems-portfolio-tracking", "package") and status != Closed)) and (labels is empty or labels != "do-not-track") ORDER BY "cf[10855]" ASC, Rank ASC

jql.rank: project = "AIPCC" AND issuetype in (Initiative, Feature) AND status != Closed ORDER BY Rank ASC
jql.features: project = "AIPCC" AND component = "AIPCC Ecosystems" AND issuetype = Feature AND status != Closed

packageRequests.rhoai-3.5.EA2: project = "AIPCC" AND component = "AIPCC Ecosystems" AND issuetype = Epic AND status != Closed AND labels in (dashboard-filed, package, package-automation-onboard) AND "Target Version[version picker (multiple versions)]" = "rhoai-3.5.EA2"

jql.reviewReadyPackages:
project = AIPCC
AND issuetype = Epic
AND status = Review
AND "Target Version" in ("3.6 EA2 RHOAI RELEASE", "3.6 EA2 RHAII RELEASE", "3.6 EA2 RHELAI RELEASE")
ORDER BY Rank ASC
jql.initiatives: project = "AIPCC" AND component = "AIPCC Ecosystems" AND issuetype = Initiative AND status != Closed
jql.strategies: project = RHAISTRAT AND issuetype = Feature AND component IN ("AIPCC Productization", "AIPCC Ecosystems") AND status != Closed AND (labels is EMPTY OR labels != "do-not-track") ORDER BY "cf[10855]" ASC, Rank ASC
jql.epics: ((project = RHAI and issuetype = Epic and component IN ("AIPCC Productization", "AIPCC Ecosystems") and status != Closed and (labels IN ("aipcc-ecosystems-portfolio-tracking", "package") or parent is empty)) or (project = AIPCC and issuetype = Epic and labels IN ("aipcc-ecosystems-portfolio-tracking", "package") and status != Closed)) and (labels is empty or labels != "do-not-track") ORDER BY "cf[10855]" ASC, Rank ASC
